resources.string: This tablet becomes an extended display of your Mac.

Direct USB, no developer options needed: with Ginga running on the Mac, plug in the cable. Android asks to open Ginga for “Second display for your Mac”; tick “Always” and the display opens by itself next time.\n\nADB, with USB debugging on: connect the cable and start Ginga on the Mac (it runs this for you):
Then tap Connect. The tablet connects to 127.0.0.1:47800, which adb forwards to the Mac.
Looking for Macs on this network… Ginga on the Mac must have Wi‑Fi turned on, on the same network.
Pick a Mac. The first time, both screens show a code to compare.
Paired · touch and hold to forget
Its identity changed. Pair again only if you trust this Mac.

A direct connection needs the Bluetooth and nearby Wi‑Fi devices permissions.
Check that your Mac shows the same code, then confirm on both devices.
